dataset.name: Nationaler Emissionszertifikatehandel certificate value
dataset.method: NEHG 2022 § 10: certificate value of 55 euro per tonne of CO2 in 2027, as the Federal Ministry of Finance gives it for the fixed-price phase (the law's table ends at 2025). Fuel suppliers pay it for the CO2 their fuel emits and pass it on in the fuel price.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: Federal Ministry of Finance (Austria): information on the NEHG 2022, the fixed certificate price by calendar year (EUR 55 for 2025 to 2027)

vehicles.description: CO2 from fuel bought in the country, per tonne

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
